entries.german:
Des Würzburger Bischofs Reinhard Bestätigungsbrief eines Gütertausches. 1178.

In nomine sanete et individue trinitatis. Reinhardus dei gratia Würtzburg. eccl. Episcopus. Notum esse cupimus omnibus tam presentibus quam post futuris, predium quod- dam fratrum de Brunnebach in parochia Reicholsheim silum esse, sc. curiam, que dicitur Lengenvelt cum suis adjacen- tii.s et curiam, que dicitur Brunnebach cum suis adjacentiis, de quibus tertia pars deeime attinebat eidem parochie. Ipsi vero fratres usi tam suo, quam aliorum bonorum virorum con- silio, domino Bopponi Coiniti de Wertheim, qui jure beueficii 15 derimam illam ab episcopatu habuit, de rebus suis in tantum contulerunt, quud ipse cum nubis resignavit, et duo predia nimm in Waldenhuaen, alterum in Sahsenhusen, ad concam- bium illius decime super altare ejusdem ecclesie, sc. Reichola- heim manu sua et uxoris sue legitime delegavit. His ita perac- tis presente Offene et advocato ejusdem parochie, postquam etiam vidimus homines seped. parochie, quibus res ea nota erat, juramento confirmasse, quod predia, que in concam- bium decime illius data erunt, multo majoris pretii quam ipsa decima essent. Ut firmior fides huic rei adhiberetur, qui- busdam fidelibus nostris, ut huic concambio interessent, fide- liter commisimus Adelberto de Hohenloch. Thimone de Win desheim. Arnoldo. Conrado duobus filiis Ruperti de Ussen- keim. Ministerialibus: Herbordo de Ussenkeim. Gumperto et Adalberto de Wertheim et adhuc quam pluribus aliis, qui concordantes juramento predict. hominum, rogatu predicti Comitis et pro remedio anime nostre deeimam illam b. Marie in Brunnebach delegavimus. Quod ergo factum est, presentis scripti pagina confirmavimus eique auetoritatem im- pressione sigilli nostri dedimus. Si quis igitur in posterum ausu temerario seu malo ingenio infringere vel infirmare at- tentaverit, anathema sit Warantha. Testes Clerici: Godefridus Prepositus. Persius Decanus. Godefridus Scholasticus. Albertus Custos. Godefridus Cantor. Bertholdus Prepositus. Eberhardus de Marmore. Godefridus de Crutheim. Conradus Cellarius. Dietricus de Bebenburch. Berengerus. Laici: Boppo Comea de Wertheim. Sigebodo de Zimmern. Crafto de Bokkesberg. Wolframus de Bebenburch. Otto de Eschenhusen. Crafto de Rettersheim. Henricus scultetus. Hartmundus de Bischofes Wineden. Wolframus de Brosoldesheim, et Conradus frater suus. Bilingus et Cadelohas et frater suus. Wuhardus. Adel- hun. Arnoldus. Hermannus. Wolfolt et ali i quam plures. Act. a. d. MCLXXV1II. regnante glorios. Roman. Imper. Friderico, Boppone urbano Comite existente.
entries.english:
Confirmation by Reinhard, Bishop of Würzburg, of an exchange of property. 1178.

In the name of the holy and undivided Trinity. Reinhard, by the grace of God Bishop of the Church of Würzburg, wishes it to be known to all, present and future, that certain property of the brothers of Brombach in the parish of Reicholzheim consists of the manor called Lengenfeld with its appurtenances and the manor called Brombach with its appurtenances, from which a third part of the tithe belonged to that parish. The brothers, acting on their own counsel and that of other good men, granted so much of their property to Lord Boppo, Count von Wertheim, who held that tithe from the bishopric as a benefice, that he surrendered it to us; in exchange for that tithe, with his own hand and that of his lawful wife, he assigned two estates to the altar of the same church, namely Reicholzheim: one at Waldenhausen and the other at Sachsenhausen.

This having been done in the presence of Offene, advocate of that parish, and after we had also seen the people of the aforesaid parish, who knew the matter, confirm on oath that the estates given in exchange for the tithe were worth much more than the tithe itself, we faithfully commissioned certain of our faithful men to witness the exchange: Adelbert von Hohenlohe, Thimo von Windsheim, Arnold, Conrad and the two sons of Ruprecht von Uissigheim; among our ministerials, Herbord von Uissigheim, Gumbert and Adelbert von Wertheim, and many others. In agreement with the sworn testimony of the aforesaid people, at the request of the aforesaid Count and for the salvation of our soul, we assigned that tithe to Saint Mary at Brombach. We have confirmed what was done by this written charter and given it authority through the impression of our seal. If anyone in the future should presumptuously or maliciously attempt to break or weaken this grant, let him be anathema.

Clerical witnesses: Godefridus, provost; Persius, dean; Godefridus, scholasticus; Albertus, custodian; Godefridus, cantor; Bertholdus, provost; Eberhard von Marmore; Godefridus von Crutheim; Conrad Cellarius; Dietrich von Bebenburg; Berengerus. Lay witnesses: Boppo, Count von Wertheim; Sigebodo von Zimmern; Crafto von Boxberg; Wolframus von Bebenburg; Otto von Eschenhausen; Crafto von Rettersheim; Heinrich, schultheiss; Hartmund von Bischofswinden; Wolframus von Brosoldesheim and his brother Conrad; Bilingus; Cadelohas and his brother; Wuhardus; Adelhun; Arnoldus; Hermannus; Wolfolt; and many others. Done in the year of the Lord 1178, during the reign of the glorious Roman Emperor Frederick, when Boppo was urban count.
